units.title: Recognize conversion rate ceiling is not set by page quality

claim.text: The source says conversion rate has a ceiling set by category, price point, and traffic quality, not usually page quality. Once the page is taken as far as it can go on clarity, offer, and proof, the next lever usually is not another design test; it becomes contribution margin on first order, future product launches, product quality, and repeat purchasing.
claim.quote: Here's a really important truth that most people won't tell you, which is that your conversion rate has a ceiling, and you don't often set that ceiling based on the page quality. You set it based on your category, your price point, and the quality of the traffic that you're sending to the website. Once you've taken the page as far as you can in regards to clarity, offer and proof, the next lever usually isn't another design test. It becomes your contribution margin on first order and future product launches and the quality of the product and the strength of your repeat purchasing because repeat customers have much higher conversion rates on the landing page which skews conversion rate up over time.

units.title: Understand the CAC argument for conversion rate

claim.text: The source explains that because conversion rate is the denominator in the CAC formula, doubling conversion rate halves CAC, which allows raising the CAC ceiling back up and could allow doubling or tripling volume; however, doubling conversion rate is described as an insane change almost never seen.
claim.quote: Because if you can double your conversion rate, because it's the denominator here, what that does is it will half your C. So, if you can take your conversion rate from 1 to 2%, it halves your CA. What does that allow? It allows you to spend a lot more on the platforms because you can allow your CAC ceiling to go back up to what it was originally, which will probably allow you to double or triple volume. So you could quite literally double to triple a business just on improving conversion rate. Now doubling conversion rate is an insane change and I've almost never seen anyone be able to effectively double their conversion rate.

claim.quote: the other things that we can do to scale the brand is we can spend more on ads or we can try to become more efficient within the platform through higher click-through rates or lower CPCs. So the cost of traffic goes down which increases session volume. Both of those levers generally require money.
